entities.summary: Keyonte Darnell George is an American professional basketball player for the Utah Jazz of the National Basketball Association (NBA). He played college basketball for the Baylor Bears. He was a consensus five-star recruit and one of the top players in the 2022 class. He is the son of professional basketball player Jason Siggers.
